# Checklist: ux
<!-- Generated by /speckit.checklist -->
<!-- Branch: 002-cms-conteudo | Date: 2026-09-05 -->

Requirement **quality** checks for the one interface this feature ships: **the Payload admin**.

This feature adds no visual vocabulary — it consumes `@fablab/ui`, and the public pages are
feature 003's. But US7 says the lab team runs the site *without a developer*, which makes the
admin a real product surface rather than a tool, and it is the surface a rotating group of
volunteers will actually live in.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK083 | Field labels are PT-BR, and the requirement states it rather than leaving it to each collection's author | [accessibility] | FR-001, US7 | [ ] |
| CHK084 | The requirement covers what a team member can do end to end — create a category, reorder classes, publish an event — not just which fields exist | [feedback] | US7 | [ ] |
| CHK085 | A team member sees only their own organization's rows, **including in relationship pickers**, which is the surface a scoped list view does not cover | [error-states] | FR-021 | [ ] |
| CHK086 | The three review states are named in the interface language the team will use, not only as enum values | [feedback] | FR-008, US7 | [ ] |
| CHK087 | A maker attempting to publish gets a **refusal**, not a silently ignored change — the requirement distinguishes the two | [error-states] | FR-008, SC-005 | [ ] |
| CHK088 | Upload rejections surface a reason the uploader can act on, in PT-BR, rather than a stack trace or a bare 400 | [error-states] | SC-006, SC-007 | [ ] |
| CHK089 | The quarantine window is accounted for in the interface: an uploaded file is not immediately available, and the requirement says what the team sees meanwhile | [feedback] | FR-014 | [ ] |
| CHK090 | **The cost of `lockDocuments: false` is stated as a UX consequence**, not only a security one: two team members can edit the same document with no warning, on a shared admin | [feedback] | FR-018, CLR-004 | [ ] |
| CHK091 | Derived counters are shown as read-only, so a team member does not try to correct a number and find the edit discarded | [feedback] | FR-020 | [ ] |
| CHK092 | Empty states are considered for a **new organization** — no categories, no content — since that is what the second lab sees on day one | [error-states] | FR-002, US8 | [ ] |
| CHK093 | Rich-text authoring is specified as the framework's default editor, with the trade-off stated, rather than left to whoever writes the first collection | [feedback] | FR-001, US7 | [ ] |
| CHK094 | The admin is reachable and usable without a developer present — no step in the team's normal workflow requires the command line | [accessibility] | US7 | [ ] |
| CHK095 | Image derivatives are stated to appear after the post-upload pass, so a missing thumbnail immediately after upload is understood as pending rather than broken | [feedback] | FR-011, spike S1 | [ ] |
